name: Promised Place - The Town of Somber Love and Repose
source:
Promised Place is a surrealist mystery horror visual novel, set in the fictional town of Oak River. 

On September 16, 1996, Cerin goes back to his hometown to finally meet his beloved childhood love Maya Renard in their promised place at the Oak Treeside. However, there was no Maya found. Later, Cerin investigates what happened and wonders why the town and the police investigation towards Maya's case seems to be a lost cause and the town conspires on hiding it.

As Cerin investigates the truth, different incidents happen, which now leads to the mystery of Oak River, the town of somber love and repose.

[From [url=https://kirinoyastudios.itch.io/promised-place-the-town-of-somber-love-and-repose]Itch.io[/url]]
